text.aria-label: Title text 'Follow by arm Injected 15 and 30 day load-shifts, day 4 to the end, 24-120 h ahead, both metering groups, 2025-10 and 2025-12. Dot: mean over Primary-events. Line: 99.6% interval (Bonferroni across 12 counted contrasts) from resampling (month, Primary) clusters. R is not drawn: its follow equals A1's. -p: noise in place of the inputs.'
text.tspan: Injected 15 and 30 day load-shifts, day 4 to the end, 24-120 h ahead, both metering groups, 2025-10 and 2025-12.
Dot: mean over Primary-events. Line: 99.6% interval (Bonferroni across 12 counted contrasts) from resampling (month, Primary) clusters.
R is not drawn: its follow equals A1's. -p: noise in place of the inputs.
